author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two ring eyes joined by a bridge, antennae arching out and hooking down, a bell body flaring to a full-width ground line; matches the Yip Yip reference. Compared with the rejected drawing, the antennae now hook like the reference and the body flares into a bell.
omissions: None significant; the eyes' tiny outer pupil dots in the reference are not drawn.
drawing_plan: SQUARE symmetric about x 24: eyes r5 at (15,18)/(33,18) with bridge y 18; antennae beziers from eye tops arching to y 6 and hooking to (6,8)/(42,8); body sides from (12,22)/(36,22) to (7,42)/(41,42); ground y 42 x 6..42.
lucide_reference: No Lucide match; ring-eye and dome construction.
